as_told.title: Voice-to-skull technology known under another inside term

plain: There is said to be a secret government program that uses microwave beams to make a person hear sound inside their head, and even to carry a spoken voice. Insiders reportedly call it the "Voice of God." The main account comes from Eric Haseltine, presented on the show as a former director at the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that intercepts communications. He says such beams can "create vibrations like sound," and that "there's a program to modulate that with voice. We call it the voice of God." He credits a document called The Shadow of Time. If true, it would mean the government can put words into someone's head with no speaker in the room. A second teller, a Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown, tells it differently. He calls the crudest of these technologies by its public name, "voice to skull," and says he never saw it himself on the inside, where he knew it by another term. Neither man gives a date or a place.
